zh.title: Delta 開辦奧斯汀至巴黎航線 成為唯一美籍航企飛往歐洲
zh.summary: Delta 明年三月開辦奧斯汀直飛巴黎；將成唯一美航奧斯汀飛歐洲
body: 航空新聞網站 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 9 日發布報導，標題為「Delta's New Paris Route Will Make It The Only US Airline Flying From Austin To Europe」，摘要指出「Delta will launch daily Austin to Paris flights in March 2027」。
這意味著 Delta Air Lines 計劃在 2027 年 3 月開辦每日往返奧斯汀至巴黎的航班，並將成為唯一一家提供奧斯汀直飛歐洲定期服務的美國航空公司。

en.title: Delta to launch daily Austin-Paris flights in March 2027, becoming only US airline from Austin to Europe
en.summary: Delta plans daily Austin-Paris service from March 2027; will be sole US carrier from Austin to Europe
body: Aviation news site Simple Flying reported on 9 September 2026 that Delta Air Lines plans to launch daily flights between Austin, Texas and Paris, France starting in March 2027. The article, titled "Delta's New Paris Route Will Make It The Only US Airline Flying From Austin To Europe," states that the new service will make Delta the sole U.S. carrier offering nonstop transatlantic flights from Austin.
According to the report, the route will operate daily from March 2027, filling a gap in direct connectivity between the Texas capital and Europe.

zh.title: 漢莎技術A330鯊魚皮貼膜進入EASA最終認證階段
zh.summary: 漢莎技術展開空中巴士A330客機AeroSHARK貼膜最終認證與試飛
body: 德國航空維修業者漢莎技術（Lufthansa Technik）已正式進入最終認證階段，以針對空中巴士A330-200與A330-300系列客機取得歐洲航空安全局（EASA）的補充型號合格證（STC）。該項目旨在將名為AeroSHARK的仿生鯊魚皮表面貼膜技術應用於廣體客機，進一步提升航機氣動效率並降低營運減碳成本。
根據漢莎技術發布的資訊，這項空中巴士系列改裝計畫選定發現航空（Discover Airlines）的一架空中巴士A330-300作為全球首架改裝的測試飛機。該飛機前往位於德勒斯登的Elbe Flugzeugwerke廠區進行貼膜施工，完成改裝後將開展為期數週的地面與試飛測試，以比對貼膜前後的實際飛行數據並支援EASA認證作業。
AeroSHARK技術由漢莎技術與巴斯夫塗料（BASF Coatings）共同開發，其微觀結構模仿鯊魚皮膚的肋條設計，能夠顯著降低飛機在飛行過程中受到的空氣阻力。漢莎技術指出，在A330客機的機身及引擎納艙塗覆該薄膜後，預計可在巡航階段降低約1%的燃油消耗與二氧化碳排放量。
在此之前，AeroSHARK已獲得認證並應用於波音777-200ER、777-300ER及777F等機型。截至2026年8月，漢莎集團旗下及合作航空公司已有22架飛機完成改裝，包含南美航空、瑞士國際航空、漢莎航空、全日空與長榮航空等。此外，漢莎技術亦於2026年7月展開針對漢莎城際航空空中巴士A319（ICAO機型代碼A319）的AeroSHARK測試作業。

en.title: Lufthansa Technik Enters Final EASA Certification Phase for AeroSHARK on Airbus A330
en.summary: Lufthansa Technik begins final certification testing for AeroSHARK sharkskin technology on Airbus A330 aircraft.
body: German maintenance, repair, and overhaul specialist Lufthansa Technik has entered the final certification phase to secure approval for modifying Airbus A330-200 and A330-300 aircraft with its AeroSHARK surface technology. The German company is seeking a Supplemental Type Certificate (STC) from the European Aviation Safety Agency (EASA), marking the expansion of the drag-reducing film onto its first Airbus widebody platform.

To support the final certification effort, a Discover Airlines Airbus A330-300 was selected as the initial test aircraft for the Airbus widebody family. The aircraft underwent surface modification at the Elbe Flugzeugwerke facility in Dresden before embarking on a series of ground and flight tests scheduled over several weeks. These test flights will generate comparative aerodynamic performance data before and after the modification to meet EASA regulatory requirements.

Developed in cooperation between Lufthansa Technik and BASF Coatings, AeroSHARK utilizes a thin, durable film structured with microscopic riblets that mirror the fluid dynamics of shark skin. On the Airbus A330ceo, the initial application covers key areas including the aircraft fuselage and engine nacelles. By optimizing airflow across these exposed surfaces during cruise flight, the technology is expected to reduce both fuel consumption and carbon dioxide emissions by around 1 percent.

Prior to targeting the Airbus A330 family, Lufthansa Technik secured regulatory approvals for Boeing 777 variants, including the 777-200ER, 777-300ER, and 777F freighters. As of August 2026, the Lufthansa Group had fitted AeroSHARK on 22 operational aircraft across commercial carriers including LATAM, SWISS, Lufthansa, All Nippon Airways, and EVA Air. Additionally, Lufthansa Technik reported in July 2026 that testing had commenced on an Airbus A319 (ICAO type code A319) flown by Lufthansa City Airlines.

zh.title: Hermeus發布Ramjet-X可從Quarterhorse釋放高馬赫測試載具
zh.summary: Hermeus推出Ramjet-X；Quarterhorse攜帶釋放；馬赫3分離巡航馬赫4；首飛預期一年內
body: Hermeus發布Ramjet-X，一種可從Quarterhorse無人機腹部釋放的消耗式超燃衝壓發動機載具。根據AeroTime報導，該公司表示Ramjet-X旨在降低高馬赫數氣動飛行測試成本。
傳統超燃衝壓發動機需依賴消耗式火箭助推器達到運作速度，Hermeus指出Quarterhorse將改為攜帶Ramjet-X至所需速度與高度後釋放，並可返航執行後續測試任務。
Hermeus將該載具定位為商業供應項目，稱之為「高馬赫飛行測試即服務」。依據發布內容，客戶可將酬載、感測器、通訊與計算系統、自主軟體、材料樣本及推進技術整合至Ramjet-X，在持續高馬赫條件下測試。
執行長Zach Shore在聲明中指出：「高速飛行測試極為昂貴，且鮮有機會嘗試。」超燃衝壓發動機測試正在佛羅里達州傑克遜維爾HEAT設施進行，高溫結構開發則在加州El Segundo總部推進，整合載具測試計畫於2027年展開。

據Axios於2026年9月9日發表的專訪，Shore透露Ramjet-X長約6.7公尺（22呎）、寬2.1公尺（7呎），分離點約馬赫3，隨後爬升至約10萬呎（約30,500公尺）並在接近馬赫4巡航數十分鐘。首飛預期在一年內，單架Quarterhorse最終可攜帶兩架載具。此架構呼應1960年代洛克希德M-21與D-21組合。Quarterhorse Mk 2.1於2026年5月第三次飛行達馬赫1.21，已獲FAA核發實驗類特別適航證。Hermeus於2026年4月完成3.5億美元C輪融資，並將總部從喬治亞州亞特蘭大遷至El Segundo。

en.title: Hermeus unveils Ramjet-X vehicle to launch from Quarterhorse at Mach 3 for high-Mach flight testing
en.summary: Hermeus reveals Ramjet-X; Quarterhorse carries/releases at Mach 3; cruise near Mach 4; first flight within a year
body: Hermeus has unveiled Ramjet-X, an expendable ramjet-powered vehicle designed to be released in flight from beneath its Quarterhorse uncrewed aircraft. According to AeroTime, the company said the vehicle is intended to reduce the cost of high-Mach airbreathing flight testing.

Ramjets produce no thrust from a standing start and conventionally depend on an expendable rocket booster to reach operating speed. Hermeus said Quarterhorse would instead carry Ramjet-X to the required speed and altitude, release it, and return for further test sorties.

The company is also positioning the vehicle as a commercial offering it calls “high-Mach Flight Test as a Service”. According to the release, customers would be able to integrate payloads, sensors, communications and computing systems, autonomy software, material samples and propulsion technologies onto Ramjet-X for testing in sustained high-Mach conditions.

Chief executive Zach Shore said in the statement: “High-speed flight testing is extremely expensive, and you don’t get many shots at it.” Ramjet engine testing is underway at the Hermeus HEAT facility in Jacksonville, Florida, and high-temperature structures are being developed at its El Segundo, California headquarters. Integrated vehicle testing is planned for 2027.

In an interview with Axios published on September 9, 2026, Shore said Ramjet-X measures roughly 6.7 meters (22 feet) long and 2.1 meters (7 feet) across. Separation would occur at about Mach 3, and the vehicle would then climb to about 100,000 feet (approximately 30,500 meters) and cruise near Mach 4 for tens of minutes. A first flight is expected within a year, and a single Quarterhorse should eventually carry two vehicles. The pairing recalls the Lockheed M-21 and D-21 of the 1960s. Quarterhorse Mk 2.1 reached Mach 1.21 on its third flight in May 2026, after the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) issued a Special Airworthiness Certificate in the Experimental Category. Hermeus closed a $350 million Series C round in April 2026 and moved its corporate headquarters from Atlanta, Georgia, to El Segundo.
